title: arenaria ciliata subsp. multicaulis
intro: Arenaria ciliata subsp. multicaulis, commonly known as sandwort, is a sub-species of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its potential benefits in reducing inflammation, improving respiratory problems, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria ciliata subsp. multicaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
